name: plan-card
title: Plan Card
description: An agent's plan before it acts: goal, numbered steps with effects and what they touch, assumptions, what it won't do, what it will ask, risk, and Accept, Accept and allow these in this chat, Request changes or Reject.

meta.whenToUse: An agent in plan mode proposes a plan and waits for the person's answer.
meta.whenNotToUse: A single action to allow (RequestCard), or a live checklist of work in progress (TaskList).
